title: Close
summary: The close button of the SIMAI Framework: a real button (focus, Enter and Space, the name «Закрыть» by default) drawing the cross with a 2px line, in three looks -- ghost, plain and media. Inside a native button it stays the decorative cross it was before 1.2.0.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: Size on the ladder: as a button the box is the icon button's, the control ladder (1/3 28px, 1/2 32, 1 40, 2 48, 3 56; on a phone 24, 28, 36, 44, 52; size 1/3 is 28 on the desktop by owner decision C27) and the cross its step; 1/4 and 4-7 are glyph sizes only, drawn by a button at the nearest ladder step. The line is 2px at every size.

height.description: The button's height (owner decisions C27, C35), as on sf-button and sf-button-icon: size sets the cross and the box's step, height picks the box's height from that step's tightness steps -- low, default, high, highest -- on the UI height ladder; the box stays square and the cross keeps its size. Size 1 on desktop 32/40/48/56, phone 28/36/44/52; without a size, a height makes it a control of its place (DEV D1 on C35): size 1, which a compact region moves down, so <sf-button-close height="low"> is 32, compact and phone 28, the notice's close; an explicit size keeps its step in a compact region (C22), as every size does; without a size or a height it stays 1/3. Inside a containing button the element is the cross only and height does nothing. A value outside the list reads as default.

appearance.description: How the close looks (owner decision C14). ghost, the default: a plain cross in the ink of its place, and a spot of --sf-surface-container-hover / -active under it on hover and press, shaped by radius. plain: no spot ever; the cross steps up from the ink step 64 to full, and the keyboard ring stands around the cross -- tags, a field's clear, an inline remove. media: over a photo or a video, a black circle at the ink steps 48 / 64 / 80 with a white cross, the same in both themes.

radius.description: The shape of the ghost spot, as the icon buttons beside it: default is the rounded square of controls, rounded a circle. plain has no spot; media is always a circle.

scheme.description: The cross's ink: the text colour, or one step quieter (it comes up to on-surface on hover). media is always white.

backdrop.description: What the close stands on. surface, the default: a page, a card, a dialog. color: a coloured banner or bar; the cross takes the place's ink (currentColor) and the ghost spot is that ink at the state steps 8 / 12.

disabled.description: Disables the button: no spot, the cross in the disabled ink, out of the tab order.

accessibility.focus: The native button is focusable and in the tab order; its name is aria-label, else the runtime word close («Закрыть»). Inside a containing button the cross is decorative and never focusable.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-close for every close or remove action: dialogs, drawers, toasts, banners (ghost), tags, a field's clear and inline remove (plain), over photos and video (media).
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not put sf-button-close inside another button for a new page: it is the button
Do not draw a bordered or filled square or circle around the cross
